verdict.rationale: Milvus is a vector database exposing SDK and server APIs, so API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never documents versioned API endpoints or a deprecation policy. Versioned docs paths (v3.0.x) and the claim that Lite, Standalone and Distributed share the same API are adjacent at best: they speak to API consistency across deployment modes, not to versioning guarantees or deprecation timelines. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on every candidate path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
